en.name: ee
en.tip: Lips spread in a smile, jaw nearly closed, tongue high and forward.

en.name: short i
en.guide: i as in 'sit' - shorter and more relaxed than 'ee'
en.tip: Lips slightly spread, jaw a little more open than for 'ee'.

en.name: eh
en.tip: Jaw half open, lips relaxed and slightly spread.

en.name: short a
en.guide: a as in 'cat' - open and bright, between 'eh' and 'ah'
en.tip: Jaw drops wide, lips slightly spread, tongue forward.

en.name: ah
en.tip: Jaw wide open, lips relaxed and unrounded, tongue low and back.

en.name: aw
en.tip: Jaw open, lips rounded loosely.

en.name: uh
en.guide: u as in 'cup' - a short, open 'uh'
en.tip: Jaw half open, lips relaxed and neutral.

en.name: short oo
en.guide: oo as in 'book' - shorter and looser than 'food'
en.tip: Lips rounded but relaxed, not pushed forward.

en.name: oo
en.tip: Lips rounded and pushed forward, jaw nearly closed.

en.name: schwa
en.guide: the weak 'uh' in 'about' - a quick, lazy vowel
en.tip: Mouth almost still, lips and jaw relaxed.

en.name: unstressed er
en.guide: the weak 'er' in 'butter' - an 'uh' coloured by the r sound
en.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue tip curled or bunched back.

en.name: stressed er
en.guide: 'ur' as in 'bird' - a long 'er' with the tongue pulled back
en.tip: Lips slightly rounded, jaw half open, tongue bunched with no touch.

en.name: eye
en.guide: 'eye' as in 'time' - starts open, glides to 'ee'
en.tip: Jaw starts wide then closes, lips spread at the end.

en.name: ow
en.guide: 'ow' as in 'now' - starts open, glides to 'oo'
en.tip: Jaw starts wide then closes while lips round.

en.name: ay
en.tip: Jaw half open, then closing, lips spreading.

en.name: oh
en.tip: Lips rounded and moving to a tighter pucker.

en.name: oy
en.tip: Lips round, then spread while the jaw closes.

en.name: p
en.guide: p as in 'pen' - a puff of air on release
en.tip: Lips pressed together, then released with a puff.

en.name: b
en.tip: Lips pressed together, voice on, soft release.

en.name: t
en.guide: t as in 'top' - puff of air at word start
en.tip: Tongue tip taps the ridge behind upper teeth; lips neutral.

en.name: d
en.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind upper teeth, voice on.

en.name: k
en.guide: k as in 'key' - puff of air at word start
en.tip: Back of tongue lifts to the soft palate; lips take the shape of the next vowel.

en.name: g
en.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate, voice on.

en.name: f
en.tip: Top teeth rest on the lower lip, air flows through.

en.name: v
en.tip: Top teeth on the lower lip, voice buzzing.

en.name: th (thin)
en.guide: th as in 'think' - air only, no voice
en.tip: Tongue tip between or against the teeth, visible; blow air.

en.name: th (this)
en.guide: th as in 'this' - the same as 'think' but voiced
en.tip: Tongue tip between the teeth, visible, with a buzz.

en.name: s
en.tip: Teeth almost closed, lips slightly spread, hissing air.

en.name: z
en.tip: Teeth almost closed, lips slightly spread, voice on.

en.name: sh
en.tip: Lips rounded and pushed slightly forward, teeth close.

en.name: zh
en.guide: the middle sound in 'measure' - a buzzing 'sh'
en.tip: Lips rounded and forward, voice on.

en.name: h
en.guide: h as in 'hat' - a breath of air
en.tip: Mouth takes the shape of the next vowel; just breathe.

en.name: ch
en.tip: Lips rounded forward, tongue stops air then releases it.

en.name: j
en.tip: Lips rounded forward, tongue stops air then releases with voice.

en.name: m
en.tip: Lips closed, voice hums through the nose.

en.name: n
en.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind upper teeth, hum through the nose.

en.name: ng
en.guide: ng as in 'sing' - never starts an English word
en.tip: Lips neutral, back of tongue to the soft palate, hum through the nose.

en.name: l
en.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind upper teeth, air around the sides.

en.name: r
en.guide: r as in 'red' - tongue never touches
en.tip: Lips rounded slightly, tongue pulled back or bunched.

en.name: y
en.tip: Lips spread, tongue high like 'ee', then glide quickly into the vowel.

en.name: w
en.tip: Lips tightly rounded, then open quickly into the vowel.

fr.name: a
fr.guide: like the 'a' in 'father' but shorter and a bit more forward
fr.tip: Jaw open, lips relaxed, tongue low and forward.

fr.name: é
fr.guide: like the 'ay' in 'say' but pure, with no glide to 'ee'
fr.tip: Lips spread a little, jaw half closed, hold still.

fr.name: è
fr.guide: like the 'e' in 'bed' - open and clear
fr.tip: Jaw half open, lips relaxed, slightly spread.

fr.name: i
fr.guide: like 'ee' in 'see' but tenser and shorter
fr.tip: Lips spread wide, jaw nearly closed.

fr.name: French u
fr.guide: say 'ee' but round your lips as for 'oo' - no English equivalent
fr.tip: Lips tightly rounded and pushed forward, tongue stays high and front.

fr.name: ou
fr.guide: like 'oo' in 'food' but tenser and shorter
fr.tip: Lips tightly rounded and pushed forward, tongue back.

fr.name: o (closed)
fr.guide: like 'o' in 'go' but pure with no 'oo' glide
fr.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half closed, hold still.

fr.name: o (open)
fr.guide: like the 'o' in 'off' (British) - short and open
fr.tip: Lips rounded loosely, jaw half open.

fr.name: eu (closed)
fr.guide: say 'ay' with your lips rounded as for 'o' - no English equivalent
fr.tip: Lips rounded and forward, jaw half closed, tongue front.

fr.name: eu (open)
fr.guide: like 'ur' in 'fur' but shorter, with rounded lips
fr.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half open, tongue front.

fr.name: e muet
fr.guide: like the weak 'uh' in 'about' but with rounded lips; often dropped
fr.tip: Lips slightly rounded, jaw relaxed.

fr.name: an
fr.guide: like 'ah' with the air going through the nose; no 'n' is pronounced
fr.tip: Jaw open, lips relaxed and slightly rounded, soft palate lowered.

fr.name: on
fr.guide: like 'oh' with the air through the nose; no 'n' is pronounced
fr.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half open, air through the nose.

fr.name: in
fr.guide: like 'eh' with the air through the nose, as in 'vin'; no 'n' is pronounced
fr.tip: Lips spread, jaw half open, air through the nose.

fr.name: un
fr.guide: like 'uh' with rounded lips and air through the nose; many speakers merge it with 'in'
fr.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half open, air through the nose.

fr.name: p
fr.guide: like English 'p' but with no puff of air
fr.tip: Lips pressed together and released gently.

fr.name: b
fr.guide: like English 'b'
fr.tip: Lips pressed together, voice on.

fr.name: t
fr.guide: like English 't' but with no puff, tongue tip touching the upper teeth
fr.tip: Tongue touches the back of the upper teeth; lips neutral.

fr.name: d
fr.guide: like English 'd' but with the tongue on the upper teeth
fr.tip: Tongue touches the back of the upper teeth, voice on.

fr.name: k
fr.guide: like English 'k' but with no puff of air
fr.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate.

fr.name: g
fr.guide: like English 'g' in 'go'
fr.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate, voice on.

fr.name: f
fr.guide: like English 'f'
fr.tip: Top teeth on the lower lip.

fr.name: v
fr.guide: like English 'v'
fr.tip: Top teeth on the lower lip, voice on.

fr.name: s
fr.guide: like English 's' in 'sun'
fr.tip: Teeth close, lips slightly spread.

fr.name: z
fr.guide: like English 'z' in 'zoo'
fr.tip: Teeth close, lips slightly spread, voice on.

fr.name: ch
fr.guide: like English 'sh' in 'ship'
fr.tip: Lips pushed forward and rounded.

fr.name: j
fr.guide: like the 's' in 'measure'
fr.tip: Lips pushed forward and rounded, voice on.

fr.name: French r
fr.guide: a soft gargle at the back of the throat, like a light 'kh' with a hum
fr.tip: Lips neutral, tongue tip down behind the lower teeth, back of tongue raised.

fr.name: m
fr.guide: like English 'm'
fr.tip: Lips closed, hum through the nose.

fr.name: n
fr.guide: like English 'n' but with the tongue on the upper teeth
fr.tip: Tongue tip on the back of the upper teeth.

fr.name: gn
fr.guide: like the 'ny' in 'canyon'
fr.tip: Middle of tongue pressed to the palate, lips neutral.

fr.name: l
fr.guide: like English 'l' but lighter, tongue tip on the upper teeth
fr.tip: Tongue tip touches the back of the upper teeth.

fr.name: y
fr.guide: like English 'y' in 'yes'
fr.tip: Lips spread, tongue high, then glide into the vowel.

fr.name: w
fr.guide: like English 'w' in 'we'
fr.tip: Lips rounded, then open quickly.

fr.name: French wu
fr.guide: say 'ee' and round your lips for 'oo' as you glide - the glide version of French u
fr.tip: Lips rounded and forward with the tongue high and front, then open quickly.

es.name: a
es.guide: like 'ah' in 'father' but shorter and crisper
es.tip: Jaw open, lips relaxed.

es.name: e
es.guide: like the 'e' in 'bed' but tenser, with no 'ay' glide
es.tip: Jaw half open, lips slightly spread; hold steady.

es.name: i
es.guide: like 'ee' in 'see' but shorter
es.tip: Lips spread, jaw nearly closed.

es.name: o
es.guide: like 'o' in 'go' but pure, with no 'oo' glide
es.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half closed; hold steady.

es.name: u
es.guide: like 'oo' in 'food' but shorter
es.tip: Lips rounded and pushed forward, jaw nearly closed.

es.name: p
es.guide: like English 'p' but with no puff of air
es.tip: Lips pressed together, gentle release.

es.name: b
es.guide: like English 'b'; used at the start of a word or after m/n
es.tip: Lips pressed together fully, voice on.

es.name: soft b
es.guide: a 'b' where the lips barely touch, between vowels; allophone of b and v
es.tip: Lips come close but do not close; air keeps flowing.

es.name: t
es.guide: like English 't' but with no puff and the tongue on the teeth
es.tip: Tongue tip touches the back of the upper teeth.

es.name: d
es.guide: like English 'd' but with the tongue on the teeth; at word start or after n/l
es.tip: Tongue tip on the back of the upper teeth, voice on.

es.name: soft d
es.guide: like the 'th' in 'this', but gentle; between vowels; allophone of d
es.tip: Tongue tip just touches the teeth, visible; air flows.

es.name: k
es.guide: like English 'k' but with no puff of air
es.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate.

es.name: g
es.guide: like English 'g' in 'go'; used at word start or after n
es.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate, voice on.

es.name: soft g
es.guide: a 'g' where the tongue barely touches, between vowels; like a gentle gargle; allophone of g
es.tip: Back of tongue near the palate without closing; air flows.

es.name: f
es.guide: like English 'f'
es.tip: Top teeth on the lower lip.

es.name: s
es.guide: like English 's' in 'sun'
es.tip: Teeth close, lips slightly spread.

es.name: th (Spain)
es.guide: like 'th' in 'thin'; used in Spain for z and ce/ci
es.tip: Tongue tip between the teeth, visible.

es.name: j
es.guide: like a rough 'h' - a scrape at the back of the throat, as in Scottish 'loch'
es.tip: Mouth open and neutral, back of tongue near the soft palate.

es.name: ch
es.guide: like English 'ch' in 'chair'
es.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue stops air then releases.

es.name: y (consonant)
es.guide: like English 'y' in 'yes' but with more friction, like a soft 'j'
es.tip: Tongue high against the hard palate, lips spread.

es.name: ll (traditional)
es.guide: like 'lli' in 'million'; in most regions merged with y
es.tip: Middle of tongue pressed up on the palate, lips spread.

es.name: m
es.guide: like English 'm'
es.tip: Lips closed, hum through the nose.

es.name: n
es.guide: like English 'n' but with the tongue on the teeth
es.tip: Tongue tip on the back of the upper teeth.

es.name: ñ
es.guide: like the 'ny' in 'canyon'
es.tip: Middle of tongue pressed on the palate, lips neutral.

es.name: l
es.guide: like English 'l' but lighter, tongue tip on the teeth
es.tip: Tongue tip touches the back of the upper teeth.

es.name: tapped r
es.guide: one quick tap of the tongue, like the 'tt' in American 'butter'
es.tip: Tongue tip flicks once against the ridge behind the upper teeth.

es.name: rolled r
es.guide: a trill - the tongue tip vibrates several times, like a motor
es.tip: Tongue tip loose near the ridge behind the teeth, lips neutral.

es.name: y glide
es.guide: like 'y' in 'yes' as the second half of a diphthong
es.tip: Lips spread, tongue high, quick glide.

es.name: w glide
es.guide: like English 'w' in 'we'
es.tip: Lips rounded, then open quickly.

zh.name: a
zh.guide: like 'ah' in 'father'
zh.tip: Jaw wide open, lips relaxed.

zh.name: o
zh.guide: like 'aw' in 'law' with rounded lips; mostly after b p m f w
zh.tip: Lips rounded, jaw half open.

zh.name: e (in ie, ei)
zh.guide: like the 'e' in 'bed' but tenser; appears in 'ie', 'ei', 'ye'
zh.tip: Lips spread, jaw half open.

zh.name: e (in ian)
zh.guide: like the 'e' in 'bed'; appears in 'ian', 'yan', 'uan'
zh.tip: Lips spread, jaw half open.

zh.name: e (back)
zh.guide: like 'uh' but with the tongue back and lips spread, not rounded - say 'oh' without rounding
zh.tip: Lips spread and relaxed, jaw half open, tongue back.

zh.name: e (weak)
zh.guide: like the weak 'uh' in 'about'
zh.tip: Mouth relaxed and nearly still.

zh.name: i
zh.guide: like 'ee' in 'see'
zh.tip: Lips spread, jaw nearly closed.

zh.name: u
zh.guide: like 'oo' in 'food'
zh.tip: Lips rounded and pushed forward, jaw nearly closed.

zh.name: ü
zh.guide: say 'ee' with the lips rounded as for 'oo' - no English equivalent
zh.tip: Lips tightly rounded and pushed forward, tongue high and front.

zh.name: er
zh.guide: like American 'er' in 'butter' as a whole syllable
zh.tip: Mouth half open, tongue tip curled back.

zh.name: z/c/s vowel
zh.guide: a buzzing 'zzz' held on, the vowel in 'zi', 'ci', 'si'; tongue stays at the 'z' position
zh.tip: Lips spread flat, teeth almost closed, tongue still.

zh.name: zh/ch/sh vowel
zh.guide: a buzzing curled-back 'r' held on, the vowel in 'zhi', 'chi', 'shi', 'ri'
zh.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue tip curled back and still.

zh.name: ong
zh.guide: like 'oo' in 'book' as in 'ong'; sits before ng
zh.tip: Lips lightly rounded, jaw half closed.

zh.name: y
zh.guide: like English 'y' in 'yes'
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue high.

zh.name: w
zh.guide: like English 'w' in 'we'
zh.tip: Lips rounded, then open quickly.

zh.name: ü glide
zh.guide: the glide version of ü: round your lips as you say 'y'; 'yu' and 'yue'
zh.tip: Lips rounded and forward, tongue high and front, then open.

zh.name: b (unaspirated p)
zh.guide: like the 'p' in 'spin' - no puff of air; pinyin writes it 'b'
zh.tip: Lips pressed together and released gently.

zh.name: p (aspirated)
zh.guide: like English 'p' in 'pie' with a strong puff of air
zh.tip: Lips pressed, then released with a puff.

zh.name: m
zh.guide: like English 'm'
zh.tip: Lips closed, hum through the nose.

zh.name: f
zh.guide: like English 'f'
zh.tip: Top teeth on the lower lip.

zh.name: d (unaspirated t)
zh.guide: like the 't' in 'stop' - no puff; pinyin writes it 'd'
zh.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind the upper teeth.

zh.name: t (aspirated)
zh.guide: like English 't' in 'top' with a strong puff of air
zh.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge, released with a puff.

zh.name: n
zh.guide: like English 'n'
zh.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind the upper teeth.

zh.name: l
zh.guide: like English 'l'
zh.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind the upper teeth.

zh.name: g (unaspirated k)
zh.guide: like the 'k' in 'sky' - no puff; pinyin writes it 'g'
zh.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate.

zh.name: k (aspirated)
zh.guide: like English 'k' in 'key' with a strong puff of air
zh.tip: Back of tongue touches the soft palate, released with a puff.

zh.name: h
zh.guide: like a rough English 'h' with friction at the back of the mouth
zh.tip: Mouth open, back of tongue close to the soft palate.

zh.name: ng
zh.guide: like 'ng' in 'sing'; only at the end of a syllable
zh.tip: Lips neutral, back of tongue to the soft palate, hum through the nose.

zh.name: j
zh.guide: like 'j' in 'jeep' but with a flatter tongue, lips spread
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue flat behind the lower teeth, front of tongue to the palate.

zh.name: q
zh.guide: like 'ch' in 'cheese' with a strong puff of air, lips spread
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue flat on the palate, released with a puff.

zh.name: x
zh.guide: like 'sh' in 'she' but with spread lips and a flat tongue
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue flat and high on the palate.

zh.name: z
zh.guide: like the 'ds' in 'adds'; no puff
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue tip on the back of the teeth.

zh.name: c
zh.guide: like the 'ts' in 'cats' with a strong puff of air
zh.tip: Lips spread, tongue tip on the teeth, released with a puff.

zh.name: s
zh.guide: like English 's' in 'sun'
zh.tip: Lips spread, teeth almost closed.

zh.name: zh
zh.guide: like 'j' in 'jump' with the tongue curled back; no puff
zh.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue tip curled back to the roof.

zh.name: ch
zh.guide: like 'ch' in 'church' with the tongue curled back and a strong puff
zh.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue curled back, released with a puff.

zh.name: sh
zh.guide: like English 'sh' in 'she' but with the tongue curled back
zh.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue tip curled back.

zh.name: r
zh.guide: like a buzzing 'zh' with the tongue curled back; the Mandarin 'r'
zh.tip: Lips slightly rounded, tongue curled back, voice on.

zh.name: Tone 1 (high)
zh.guide: high and level, like holding a sung high note
zh.tip: Mouth stays open and steady; no movement.

zh.name: Tone 2 (rising)
zh.guide: rising, like a surprised 'what?'
zh.tip: Mouth steady; a small lift of the chin as the pitch rises.

zh.name: Tone 3 (dipping)
zh.guide: falls low then rises, like a doubtful 'well...'; often just low in speech
zh.tip: Chin drops slightly on the low point.

zh.name: Tone 4 (falling)
zh.guide: sharp fall, like a firm 'No!'
zh.tip: Jaw drops quickly and the sound is short and forceful.

zh.name: Neutral tone
zh.guide: short, light and unstressed; pitch follows the previous tone
zh.tip: Small, quick, relaxed movement.
